dict.string: SaneVideo creates beautiful video content by accessing your camera. Your privacy is our priority—recordings stay on your Mac.
SaneVideo captures crystal-clear audio to make your videos truly shine. Audio is processed locally and never leaves your device.
SaneVideo lets you record your screen effortlessly to create tutorials, demos, and professional content right from your Mac.
SaneVideo records your screen only when you start screen capture. Recordings stay on your Mac unless you export or share them.
SaneVideo generates intelligent captions to make your content accessible to everyone. All processing happens on-device for maximum privacy.
